digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET criterion
propositions: Explicit review-plan on bug tickets with non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to full blocking LLM criteria, determined by persisted ticket state at both precheck and route_criteria seams without CLI flags or schema changes.
Gerrit DET criterion blocks bug commits exceeding 150 non-test lines that lack a current or code-drifted plan-review attestation, with teaching message for remediation.

Plan-review attestations are verified cross-host using opcert machinery (opcert_from_record → trusted_env_keyring → verify_opcert → compute_validity) rather than own-env plan_review_status, accepting certified/stale-code/stale-head verdicts.

Non-test line classification excludes tests/** and conftest.py; all other paths (src, scripts, docs, workflows) count as non-test and must be tested in backtest against the 113-commit planning corpus.
Bug claim-time exemption remains unchanged and ungated; only explicit review-plan invocations on bugs with declared non-test impact trigger escalation.
Backtest validates exact set equality: flagged commits match the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive fixes with zero false positives from 100 mechanical changes.
